comments.value:
please please pleeeease

I'd love to develop assets using stuff like this
parameter named (Vibrate) and have the number value a float for more control over how much it vibrates

Also the ability to toggle it in the safety settings in the VRC menu would be nice! ^w^

But another thing I would love to see alongside this is the ability to select what kind of device and what area the haptic feedback goes to, so devices such as bhaptics could have world integrated support... 

The second part is unrealistic, I know, but I mainly think it would be nice moving forward for eventual integration with (hopefully) a larger more affordable market of haptics.
Anyone whos taking a look at PSVR2's Horizon gameplay can tell this would be a great feature, but should be behind a safety check for friends or shown avatars only. Or alternatively turned off.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

details:
This would allow for some immersive avatar features such as a gun vibrating when shooting, bow vibrating when you're drawing an arrow on a bow, or vibrations when high-fiving your friends.

For example, using contacts to detect your hand hitting another hand, having a toggle on the contact component for "haptic vibrate on-enter", or maybe a more indepth state behavior component for the animator, and boom you got a super immersive high-five :-)
title: Haptics in the avatar SDK
